title: Crafting Recipe
description: A comprehensive schema for crafting recipes with narrative integration, LLM-GM guidance, and enhanced mechanics.

id.description: Unique, machine-readable ID for the recipe, e.g., 'recipe_basic_blaster' or 'recipe_force_artifact'.

name.description: Human-readable name of the crafted item.

recipe_type.description: The primary category of item being crafted.

era.description: The primary era this recipe is most associated with, e.g., 'Galactic_Republic', 'Galactic_Empire', 'New_Republic'.

rarity.description: Rarity of the recipe itself, affecting how it's learned or discovered.

narrative.description: Rich narrative description of the crafting process, its significance, and role in the galaxy. Used by LLM-GM for storytelling.

flavor_text.description: Iconic quote, description, or memorable phrase that captures the essence of this crafting process.

cultural_significance.description: Description of how this crafting process is viewed and valued by different cultures and groups in the galaxy.

description.description: Detailed description of the crafting process and the resulting item.

crafting_process.description: Detailed step-by-step description of how the crafting process works.

origin_story.description: The history and origin of this crafting technique or recipe.

connections.description: Universal connections to any game object - factions, species, classes, locations, etc.

target_id.description: ID of the target object (faction, species, class, location, etc.).

target_type.description: The type of object being connected to.

relationship.description: The nature of the relationship, e.g., 'Developed By', 'Taught By', 'Common Among', 'Restricted To', 'Iconic To'.

narrative.description: Description of how these objects are connected.

mechanical_benefit.description: Optional mechanical benefit from this connection.

iconic_examples.description: Famous or notable examples of this crafting process from Star Wars canon.

famous_crafters.description: Notable individuals who have mastered this crafting technique.

famous_instances.description: Notable events or moments involving this crafting process.

narrative_hooks.description: Story hooks and narrative elements related to this crafting process.

adventure_seeds.description: Potential adventure ideas that could involve this crafting process.

character_connections.description: Ways characters might be connected to or affected by this crafting process.

typical_missions.description: Types of missions or tasks typically associated with this crafting process.

cultural_impact.description: How this crafting process affects the cultures and societies of the galaxy.

technological_significance.description: The technological implications and significance of this crafting process.

difficulty.description: The DC for the crafting check required to successfully create this item.

crafting_time.description: Time requirements for the crafting process.

base_time.description: Base time in hours required for crafting.

multiplier.description: Time multiplier (0.5 for half time, 2.0 for double time)

materials.description: Required materials for the crafting process. Can specify exact items or use tag requirements for flexible material gathering.

item_id.description: ID of the specific item required (use this OR tag_requirement, not both).

tag_requirement.description: Alternative to item_id - allows any item with the specified tag to fulfill this requirement.

tag.description: The tag that qualifying items must have (e.g., 'metal_plate', 'power_cell', 'electronic_component').

quantity.description: How many items with this tag are needed.

quality_penalty.description: Penalty to crafting check when using lower-quality tagged items (e.g., -2 for scrap materials).

quality_bonus.description: Bonus to crafting check when using higher-quality tagged items (e.g., +2 for premium materials).

quantity.description: Quantity of the material required (required if using item_id, optional if using tag_requirement).

rarity.description: Rarity of the material, affects availability and cost.

substitutes.description: Alternative materials that can be used instead.

tools.description: Required tools and equipment for the crafting process.

tool_id.description: ID of the required tool or equipment.

proficiency_required.description: Whether proficiency with the tool is required.

quality_bonus.description: Bonus to crafting check if using a high-quality version of this tool.

skills.description: Skills required for the crafting process.

skill_name.description: Name of the skill used for crafting (e.g., 'Intelligence (Technology)', 'Dexterity (Sleight of Hand)').

proficiency_bonus.description: Additional bonus if proficient in this skill.

primary.description: Whether this is the primary skill for the crafting check.

prerequisites.description: Requirements that must be met before attempting this crafting process.

value.description: Specific value for the prerequisite (e.g., '5' for level, 'fighter' for class).

result.description: The item that results from successful crafting.

item_id.description: ID of the resulting crafted item.

quality_modifiers.description: Quality levels based on crafting check success margin.

check_margin.description: Margin of success required for this quality level.

effects.description: Effects granted at this quality level.

failure_effects.description: Effects that occur when crafting fails.

failure_margin.description: Margin of failure that triggers this effect.

special_effects.description: Special effects that can occur during crafting.

conditions.description: Conditions that must be met for this effect.

cost.description: Cost information for the crafting process.

base_cost.description: Base cost in credits for materials and tools.

experience_reward.description: Experience points gained for successfully crafting this item.

reputation_effects.description: Effects on reputation with various factions.

faction.description: Faction or group affected by this crafting.

narrative_outcomes.description: List of narrative outcomes or role-playing opportunities related to this crafting process.

image_generation.description: Data source for modular AI art generation engine.

base_prompt.description: Detailed foundational prompt for generating a 'stock image' of this crafting process, with bracketed placeholders for customizable parts.

contextual_modifiers.description: Modifiers defining how this crafting process adds flavor and context to other image prompts.

target_type.description: The type of image this modifier applies to (e.g., 'Character_Portrait', 'Location', 'Workshop_Scene').

modifier_text.description: Text to append to the base prompt when this crafting process is part of the context.

ui.description: User interface assets and display information.

image.description: Path to the crafting process's representative image.

icon.description: Path to the crafting process's icon for UI display.

themes.description: Thematic elements associated with this crafting process.

mood.description: The emotional tone or atmosphere associated with this crafting process.
